title: Famous Hollywood Sign Electric Mountain Bike Tour
blurb:
Join us on this guided electric mountain biking adventure to the iconic Hollywood Sign. Get fitted on one of our premium 2025 full-suspension electric mountain bikes and receive helmet, eyewear, and gloves—everything you need for an effortless ride through the Hollywood Hills. Ride top-tier bikes from Husqvarna, Specialized, and Haibike as you cruise through scenic hills, pass by Lake Hollywood Park, and snap fun photos near the Hollywood Sign.

During this 2‑hour experience, the electric assist makes it feel like a leisurely bike ride from start to finish. Soon enough, you’ll find yourself riding above the Hollywood Sign, taking in stunning views of the ocean and the vibrant city of Los Angeles—all at your own pace on this guided tour.
